context: Parametric foot pedal or treadle with a front pivot
implementation: Model the hinge support as a crossbar or knuckles, then subtract a Y-axis cylinder using the same center in the base and pedal shell.
checks: pin bore is a real cut

context: Ribbed nonslip pedal plate from STL reference
implementation: Extract one rib cross-section from the STL and linear_extrude that profile along the rib length instead of guessing a cylinder.
checks: surface area and volume are close

context: Small mechanical switch retained inside a printed base
implementation: Create two parallel rails and subtract through holes along the service direction. Leave the center open for the switch body.
